title: Unitary normalizers in finite-dimensional inclusions
summary: We study regular inclusions of finite-dimensional von Neumann algebras from a matrix-theoretic perspective. To this end, we introduce a new combinatorial invariant of an inclusion, called the normalizer matrix, which encodes the structure of the normalizer purely at the level of the inclusion matrix. Using this invariant, we obtain a complete characterization of regular inclusions of finite-dimensional von Neumann algebras.
